entries.label: Dataclass
Context Manager
entries.command:
from contextlib import contextmanager
@contextmanager
def timer():
    start = time.time()
    yield
    print(f"Took {time.time() - start:.2f}s")

with timer():
    expensive_operation()
entries.description: Create reusable setup/teardown blocks with the with statement

entries.label: f-String Formatting
entries.command:
name = 'DevDeck'
print(f'{name:>20}')       # right-align
print(f'{3.14159:.2f}')    # 2 decimals
print(f'{1000000:,}')      # comma separator
entries.description: Format numbers, alignment, and precision inside f-strings

entries.label: Enumerate with Index
entries.command:
for i, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
    print(f"{i}. {item}")
entries.description: Loop with index — start parameter sets the initial count
